source.name: Dubai Media Office, Dubai Department of Economy and Tourism partners with Dubai Basketball
source.quote: The Dubai logo and visitdubai.com website also now features on the back of the team's shirts

note: Founding sponsor; Dubai logo and visitdubai.com on the back of the shirts in the first season. DET remains a listed club partner, but the Dubai/Visit Dubai branding does not appear on the 2026/27 kit (the back is now Equiti, per the club's September 2026 kit-launch and store photos).
